title: USGS water, New York
about: The newest reading of every New York stream gauge USGS keeps: discharge and gage height, as the gauge last reported, from USGS's Water Data API (public, no key). The live edge of databook-water, whose pages hold each site's daily history.

streams.name: usgs_water.latest
streams.about: A gauge's reading as caught: a site (USGS's own key, USGS-<number>, leading zeros kept), a parameter (00060 discharge in ft^3/s, 00065 gage height in ft), when it was read, its value, Provisional or Approved, and its codes (ICE, EQUIP, ESTIMATED, DISCONTINUED and the like, as USGS writes them). Each catch-up adds the readings newer than the last; a reading is provisional until USGS approves it, months later, in the book.
